entries.f935a7aa5e008c7d: It is advancing the 5-year "Medium-Term Management Plan 2028" with 2024 as its first year. Its basic policies are: (1) proactive investment in growth businesses and creation of new businesses, (2) improvement of profitability by deepening existing businesses, (3) practice of Sustainability Transformation, and (4) promotion of GRC. Under "Long-Term Vision 2050," which sets its future desired state as "practice of sustainable business strategies considerate of the environment, society and regions," it works on expansion into the life science field with medical materials and collagen materials, development and expanded sales of functional materials, and commercialization of "Bakamatsutake," among other things.
